jobs.description:
**Position: SAP FICA Senior Consultant/Consultant** 




**Location: India (Remote)** 




**Employment: Full Time (EOR through Deel)** 




**Reports to: Delivery Manager, SAP Practice** 




  





**About the job** 




  





 At VertexOne, helping utilities provide the best customer service experience is what we do. VertexOne is the recognized leader in SaaS platforms for utilities across North America. Through a wide range of innovative services and solutions, VertexOne helps utilities deliver a compelling customer experience; reducing the cost to serve customers, increasing operational efficiency, improving customer satisfaction, and driving utility operations forward. It’s been in the DNA of our people since we started supporting utilities’ customer experience needs over 20 years ago. And that commitment continues to this day.
 



  





 Our team members are our greatest assets, so we pride ourselves on being ‘Employee First’. As such, we listen to what our employees have to say and find ways to incorporate their ideas into the company. Whether it’s new technology, career development opportunities, or fun events, we find new ways to keep our employees engaged and incentivized to grow within the company. Our employees' well\-being—both physical and mental—is a top priority at VertexOne. That's why we foster a 100% remote and flexible environment and encourage work\-life balance.
 



  





 VertexOne is proudly Certified as a Great Place to Work®. Great Place to Work® is the global authority on workplace culture, employee experience, and leadership behaviors proven to deliver market\-leading revenue, employee retention and increased innovation. VertexOne is dedicated to prioritizing the employee experience and creating an exceptional company culture.
 



  





**Position Overview:** 
 Configure and build SAP ISU application in FICA module. Provide functional design and support for North America based utility clients of VertexOne. Collaborate with the client and NA team members to gather requirements, develop and deploy solutions.
 



  





**Primary Responsibilities:** 




  




* Should possess SAP FICA knowledge for preparation of business blueprints, business process plan (BPP), functional documents, and test cases etc.
* Should have knowledge of the Meter to Cash
* Should have experience in FICA Dunning/Collection Strategy, and the management of dunning by collection strategy.
* Experience in configuring FICA Events and BRF.
* Strong knowledge of clearing strategy, clearing rules.
* Experience in Cash Desk and clarifications.
* Strong knowledge of month\-end and period\-end closing and FICA to FICO GL integration.
* Experience in the de\-regulated/Regulated energy market.
* Develop templates and methods to improve the efficiency of application support
* Gather and prioritizes relevant SAP Business requirements and designing the appropriate solution
* Understands configuration dependencies and inter\-relationships between other modules of SAP such as Device Management, CS/CRM, Billing and design and troubleshoot in the area with this knowledge
* Defines test scenarios to cover full scope of the business as well as creating master data and carry out the unit, cycle and integration tests



  





**Minimum Qualifications:** 




  




* Bachelor/Master’s Degree in Commerce, Chartered Accountant, Master’s in Business Administration or degree in Finance or equivalent degrees.
* At least 6\+ years of experience in SAP application
* Should have minimum of one full life\-cycle implementation experience
* Should have mature inter\-personnel and communication skills, both written and oral



  





**Desired Skills:** 



* Formal training or certifications in SAP FICA
* Experience in SAP Implementation and Support
* Knowledge of SAP IS\-Utilities environment would be an added advantage
* Conceptual understanding of relational databases and middleware technology.



  





**About VertexOne** 




  





 VertexOne is the leading provider of cloud\-based SaaS software solutions powering the next generation of customer experience for utilities, energy retailers, and energy transition providers.
 



  





 With over 30 years of experience and more than 350 customers in the cloud, we capitalize on our deep expertise to provide a wide range of innovative solutions for digital transformation, revenue optimization, and data\-driven efficiency operations surrounding the customer.
 



  





 From Customer Information Systems (CIS) and Mobile Workforce Management (MWM) to Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) and Digital Customer Engagement and self\-service portals, we empower our customers to deliver a compelling customer experience, reduce costs to serve, increase operational efficiency, and improve customer satisfaction.
 



  





 For more information on how VertexOne allows you to enhance the digital customer experience, improve revenue management, and leverage data analytics, visit https://www.vertexone.net.

jobs.title: SAP Application Development (AD) & Application Management Services (AMS) Manager
jobs.description:
**SAP Application Development (AD) \& Application Management Services (AMS) Manager**


**PRIMARY JOB PURPOSE**


Responsible for leading and governing SAP Application Development (AD) and Application Management Services (AMS) across the enterprise SAP landscape, ensuring the successful delivery of enhancements, and support services aligned to business objectives.


The role acts as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, SAP functional and technical teams, architects, project managers, and service providers to ensure effective planning, prioritization, execution, and support of SAP solutions. The candidate will be accountable for driving service excellence, managing vendors and delivery teams, overseeing execution, and ensuring stable SAP operations across all business\-critical processes and modules.


**KEY POSITION ACCOUNTABILITIES**


* Lead the delivery and governance of SAP Application Development (AD) and Application Management Services (AMS) across multiple SAP modules and business functions.


* Act as the central point of coordination between business stakeholders, SAP functional teams, technical teams, architects, project managers, and service providers.


* Manage SAP continuous improvement initiatives from inception through deployment and stabilization.


* Ensure effective delivery of AMS services, including Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, Service Request Management, and Release Management.


* Establish and monitor service levels, operational KPIs, ticket backlogs, aging incidents, customer satisfaction metrics, and vendor performance.


* Drive prioritization and governance of project demands, enhancement requests, and production support activities to ensure alignment with business priorities.


* Collaborate with business process owners across functions including Sales, Procurement, Manufacturing, Finance, Supply Chain, Logistics and Customer Service to identify and deliver technology solutions.


* Coordinate cross\-functional solution delivery involving SAP modules such as SD, MM, PP, PM, FI/CO, EWM, BRIM, and other integrated solutions as applicable.


* Manage SAP AMS provider, ensuring contractual commitments, service quality, and delivery expectations are consistently achieved.


* Lead major incident management activities, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and continuous service improvement initiatives.


* Support budget planning, resource management, capacity planning, risk management, and project portfolio governance activities.


* Provide regular communication and status reporting to business leadership, IT management, and project governance boards.


* Build and maintain high\-performing SAP support and delivery teams while fostering collaboration, accountability, and a customer\-focused culture.


**SELECTION CRITERIA**


**Essential**


* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related discipline.


* Minimum 12\-15 years of SAP experience with strong understanding of end\-to\-end enterprise business processes.


* Minimum 3 years of leadership experience managing SAP Application Development (AD) and/or Application Management Services (AMS) teams.


* Proven experience managing SAP projects, enhancements, support services, and vendor delivery engagements.


* Deep functional expertise in Quote\-to\-Cash (Q2C), with sufficient understanding of adjacent business processes and modules.


* Strong understanding of IT Service Management processes including Incident, Problem, Change, Release, and Service Level Management.


* Experience managing managed\-service providers, offshore delivery teams, and external implementation partners.


* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, competing demands, risks, and stakeholder expectations in a complex global environment.


* Experience in SAP S/4HANA environments.


* Strong leadership, communication, stakeholder management, conflict resolution, and decision\-making skills.


* Experience managing project plans, budgets, resource forecasting, and delivery governance.


**Desirable**


* Experience managing both Application Development and AMS functions within a global SAP landscape.


* SAP certification in any functional, technical, or project management discipline.


* ITIL Foundation or equivalent IT Service Management certification.


* Project Management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, Scrum, or SAP Activate.


* Basic understanding of ABAP, interfaces, workflows, forms, and SAP development lifecycle.


**WORK ENVIRONMENT FACTORS**


* Office\-based / Remote working model.


* Responsible for ensuring compliance with company Health, Safety, Security, and Risk Management policies.


* Operates within a global support and delivery model supporting business users across APAC, Europe, and the Americas.


* Flexibility to support major incidents, critical project milestones, go\-live activities, and leadership escalations outside standard business hours when required.


* Regular engagement with senior business stakeholders, technology leadership teams, implementation partners, and managed service providers.
